The public Hugging Face Space contains the complete `softchart/` package used by the deployed demo. This repository vendors that source at the pinned revision so inference code does not drift at runtime.

## Default pretrained model

- Repository: `JacobLinCool/softchart-v17`
- Hugging Face snapshot observed during validation: `0fe27081cd9102b1eede14c1b7aff5327851ec4b`
- `model.safetensors` SHA-256: `5df2e05ec3720c5c4b69b26a540c56bd14ab5cb5ce875c304486466f69f99a68`
- Validated capabilities: dual slot/time generation, beat head, plan conditioning, sibling conditioning, style conditioning
- Parameter count: 7,870,467

The model weights are downloaded through Hugging Face on first use and are not committed to this repository.
